title: Stage 8 current-MultiXact canonical authority and terminal-reference release matrix

included: ordinary Stage 8 point UPDATE+COMMIT current-MultiXact member proof
current and rolled canonical TT segment lookup
CTRC grant, receipt, terminal close, exact cleanout, durability settlement, and release certification
pre-mutation census and terminal discharge for ordinary shared heap ITL/UBA
excluded: shared catalog and shared WAL parity
positive recovery of lost volatile CTRC journals or seal coordinators
a new transaction status authority or background process

evidence_classes.ORACLE_FACT: Directly supported by cited Oracle public documentation.
evidence_classes.EVIDENCE_INFERENCE: Necessary implication of Oracle facts plus the frozen PGRAC architecture; not claimed as an Oracle internal implementation detail.
evidence_classes.PGRAC_ADAPTATION: PGRAC-specific representation, algorithm, wire, lock, or test contract.
evidence_classes.POSTGRESQL_COMPATIBILITY: PostgreSQL-native MultiXact, CLOG, subtrans, wait-policy, or TM_Result behavior retained by the approved adaptation.

invariants.name: CANONICAL_BYTES_ONLY
invariants.text: Only the exact canonical physical TT slot sampled under stable block-0 current authority may provide ACTIVE, COMMITTED, or ABORTED transaction state.

invariants.name: EXACT_IDENTITY
invariants.text: The accepted identity is the exact origin, canonical segment, segment generation, slot offset, slot wrap, and xid; locator or allocator metadata alone is never a verdict.

invariants.name: ACTIVE_BEFORE_DEPENDENCY
invariants.text: Canonical ACTIVE publication happens before dependent undo, ITL, tuple, heap WAL, GCS image, or member-proof exposure.

invariants.name: CURRENT_ACTIVE_OWNER
invariants.text: An ACTIVE result from the allocator-current segment additionally requires a stable exact ACTIVE allocator-owner observation; terminal results may use an exact matching terminal owner or a stable absent owner.

invariants.name: ROLLED_OWNER_NOT_AUTHORITY
invariants.text: For a stably rolled segment, the current-owner index is not consulted. A unique physical locator, canonical bytes, native bracket, generation, root, epoch, and admission remain mandatory.

invariants.name: TERMINAL_NATIVE_BRACKET
invariants.text: A COMMITTED or ABORTED verdict requires matching canonical terminal bytes and a matching stable native terminal bracket. An exact COMMITTED slot with a stable native in-progress bracket is not a terminal verdict and may only enter the conservative live transition rows; every other conflict or incomplete terminal publication is UNKNOWN.

invariants.name: PREPARED_DISTINCT
invariants.text: PREPARED is neither ACTIVE nor terminal for the Stage 8 current-MultiXact positive path and therefore produces no positive member proof.

invariants.name: WHOLE_BATCH
invariants.text: Every descriptor member must have one exact proof bound to its ordinal, xid, role, origin, epoch, request, and descriptor hash; any missing, duplicate, partial, unknown, or mismatched member makes the whole proof set UNKNOWN.

invariants.name: NO_RETRY_AFTER_MUTATION
invariants.text: RETRY_REQUIRED is legal only before any heap, ITL, undo, shared-page, or proof-publication mutation. Drift detected after mutation is an invariant violation and fails closed.

invariants.name: NO_WAIT_UNDER_HEAP_CONTENT
invariants.text: No network, file I/O, block-0 current acquisition, extent claim, recycle, autoextend, victim selection, or blocking non-heap lock occurs while a heap content lock is held.

invariants.name: UNKNOWN_PRECEDENCE
invariants.text: An UNKNOWN member, malformed context, or unprovable updater successor takes precedence over otherwise compatible or terminal members.

invariants.name: NO_PARTIAL_FALLBACK
invariants.text: No current-MultiXact failure may fall back to local pg_multixact decoding for a foreign descriptor, raw xid CLOG/ProcArray authority, request-local rolled-live projection, overlay repair, or legacy ticket authority.

invariants.name: RELEASE_NOT_STATUS_AUTHORITY
invariants.text: CTRC journals, receipts, ACKs, digests, dependency vectors, WAL certificates, and release bits prove reference discharge only and never provide ACTIVE, COMMITTED, or ABORTED status.

invariants.name: REGISTER_BEFORE_REFERENCE
invariants.text: A nonzero origin grant and requester-local PREPARED receipt exist before any ordinary ITL/UBA, current-MX, updater-edge or recomposed-survivor physical-TT dependency is published; APPLIED precedes the first page mutation.

invariants.name: CLOSE_BEFORE_CENSUS
invariants.text: Terminal census closes the exact key and grant generation at every origin-recorded touched node before freezing its receipt range.

invariants.name: PREPARED_MUST_DRAIN
invariants.text: A participant release ACK is impossible while any matching receipt remains PREPARED; timeout or backend loss cannot imply cancellation.

invariants.name: CLEANOUT_BEFORE_RELEASE
invariants.text: Every APPLIED reference is proven absent or rewritten to a terminal-independent page representation before participant ACK, with successor receipts preceding predecessor removal.

invariants.name: DURABILITY_BEFORE_CERTIFICATE
invariants.text: Every participant cleanout WAL LSN and dependency-vector component is durable before the origin emits the sole release certificate.

invariants.name: LOSS_RETAINS
invariants.text: Journal, boot, formation, admission, participant, ACK, checksum, or pre-certificate coordinator uncertainty retains or blocks the exact terminal slot.

invariants.name: BOUNDED_FAIL_CLOSED
invariants.text: CTRC shared memory is bounded and activation-sized; exhaustion refuses before mutation and never evicts a live receipt or permits untracked publication.

invariants.name: COMMIT_HORIZON_STILL_REQUIRED
invariants.text: Committed release requires both exact CTRC proof and the existing valid commit-SCN horizon; aborted release requires exact CTRC proof and durable ABORTED predecessor.

invariants.name: COMPLETE_DEPENDENCY_CENSUS
invariants.text: Every Stage 8 ordinary ITL/UBA, current-MX, updater-edge and recomposed-survivor physical-TT dependency is registered before mutation or is source-proven local/unreachable; a missing or skipped legacy ITL terminal hint is never release evidence.

batch_contract.descriptor_authority: The MXID origin alone returns the immutable ordered member descriptor.
batch_contract.member_authority: Each member xid origin alone returns its current exact member proof.
batch_contract.requester_authority: The requester alone applies target lock mode, wait policy, tuple revalidation, successor proof, and recomposition.
batch_contract.success: CMX_RESOLVE_OK only when every ordinal has one exact, non-UNKNOWN proof and every reply binding matches the request and full descriptor hash.
batch_contract.failure: Any partial, missing, duplicate, overlap, wrong-origin, wrong-epoch, wrong-hash, malformed, timeout, denied, supported-limit, or UNKNOWN input produces whole-batch non-OK; no subset is consumed.

terminal_reference_protocol.status_authority: canonical physical TT slot sampled under exact block-0 current authority

publication_id_encoding.encoding: ascending TLV: uint16 tag, uint16 byte length, fixed little-endian value; no omitted, duplicate or unknown tag

target_encoding.encoding: ascending TLV: uint16 tag, uint16 byte length, fixed little-endian value; byte arrays use their exact listed length
target_encoding.finalization: pending ITL/offnum target is rewritten field-by-field to its exact target before the PREPARED-to-APPLIED release-CAS; predecessor_page_lsn/scn are the exact pre-mutation sample, so later cleanout rejects regression but never requires an unknowable post-mutation equality or treats a newer LSN alone as absence; an unfinalized target cannot be ACKed except through exact CANCELLED_PREMUTATION disposition

generation_contract.zero: invalid for grant_generation, seal_generation, journal_sequence, key_sequence and journal_slot_generation
generation_contract.grant_generation: uint32 node-global monotonic allocation when an exact ACTIVE key first opens; never changes while that key is OPEN; wrap or exhaustion BLOCKED
generation_contract.seal_generation: uint64 node-global monotonic allocation at BEGIN_SEAL; no wrap or reuse
generation_contract.journal_sequence: uint64 node-global monotonic allocation at PREPARE; no wrap or modulo alias
generation_contract.key_sequence: uint64 participant-key-local contiguous allocation 1..N for each exact key/grant; duplicate exact publication reuses its sequence; conflict/gap/wrap BLOCKED
generation_contract.journal_slot_generation: nonzero increment on every physical receipt-slot reuse; wrap retires the slot

origin_registry_contract.creation: reserve bounded origin-key entry before canonical ACTIVE publication and open it with nonzero grant plus empty touched set before publication success
origin_registry_contract.missing: an interrupted or missing registry is unknown/BLOCKED, never a positive empty touched set
origin_registry_contract.touch_before_use: record exact requester node, boot incarnation and capability generation before ACTIVE proof enqueue or local ordinary ITL receipt prepare
origin_registry_contract.identity_change: same node with different boot/capability/formation/admission under one grant blocks; never replace or merge
origin_registry_contract.zero_touched: legal only from the still-present exact OPEN registry proving no positive grant use
origin_registry_contract.terminal_zero_grant: terminal or UNKNOWN proof with grant zero is decision input only; it cannot prepare a receipt or move/copy a physical-TT-dependent member, which must be terminal-projected/removed in the same mutation or left/refused before mutation

wire_contract.grant_field: ClusterCurrentMemberProof.reserved8[0..3] little-endian nonzero ctrc_grant_generation for ACTIVE/SELF only
wire_contract.request_key_reconstruction: field-decode little-endian TT key with both reserved words zero; system_identifier from authenticated local cluster; segment_id=zero_extend(undo_segment_id); slot_offset=tt_slot_id-1; uint64 epoch fits uint32 and equals embedded epoch; derived owner/origin/slot, authenticated origin source, touched participant destination, capability/root/formation/admission all exact; source and destination node ids in 0..15; selector resolves exactly one stored full key
wire_contract.reply_tail_rule: all zero through BLCKSZ; ACK length is 416 only for LOCAL_RELEASE_ACK and zero otherwise; PENDING_DRAIN is never certificate evidence
wire_contract.formation_dependency_domain: target OPEN requires every admitted node id in 0..15 and admitted count <= CLUSTER_SF_DEP_MAX_ORIGINS; v1 never truncates/remaps/hashes

participant_ack_contract.nonempty_positive: first_key_sequence=1; last_key_sequence=total=N>0; PREPARED=APPLIED=0; CANCELLED+CLEANED=N; ACK_FROZEN=N; global journal min/max nonzero and gaps allowed
participant_ack_contract.empty_positive: persistent close-before-proof tombstone only; key/global sequences, counts, local LSN and vector all zero; ZERO_RANGE|ALL_DURABLE; SHA-256 empty digest

digest_contract.encoding: canonical little-endian length-delimited bytes; nonempty participant rows sorted by key_sequence and exact 416-byte ACKs sorted by participant node_id
row_components: uint32_le canonical target_encoding length plus bytes
16 uint64_le required-LSN entries in node-id order
digest_contract.target_rule: CLEANED dispositions require finalized exact target; only CANCELLED_PREMUTATION may retain canonical pending target
digest_contract.nonempty_row_derivation: SHA-256(ROW domain || uint64_le(N) || for key_sequence 1..N: uint32_le(row_bytes_length) || row_bytes)
digest_contract.empty_row_derivation: sole persistent N=0 tombstone uses SHA-256(empty byte string), with no domain or count bytes
digest_contract.ackset_derivation: SHA-256(ACKSET domain || uint16_le(participant_count) || in ascending participant node id: uint32_le(416) || all 416 ACK bytes including CRC32C)
digest_contract.wal_derivation: first 16 hash-output bytes of ackset_derivation without integer byte-order conversion
digest_contract.authority: digest is integrity, idempotency and audit evidence only; exact key, counts, ranges, durable LSNs and typed ACK results remain mandatory

wal_contract.touched_bitmap_rule: v1 permits only node-id bits 0..15; bits 16..127 must be zero and touched bitmap must equal the frozen origin registry exactly
wal_contract.redo_admission_rule: runtime emitter validates live root/formation/admission before WAL; redo trusts the valid WAL record and exact storage/segment/slot predecessor and does not require the historical formation to be currently OPEN

release_rules.committed: exact COMMITTED predecessor plus canonical CTRC release bit plus valid commit_scn plus same-epoch valid folded horizon with commit_scn <= horizon
release_rules.aborted: exact durable ABORTED predecessor plus canonical CTRC release bit; no wall-clock or SCN guess
release_rules.segment: every terminal slot independently satisfies its committed or aborted rule before whole-segment recyclable/reuse

capacity_contract.allocation_time: postmaster shared-memory sizing before R4 target OPEN
capacity_contract.overflow: checked Size arithmetic and activation refusal
capacity_contract.runtime_full: REFUSE_CAPACITY before mutation; wake existing cleaner outside locks; no eviction or untracked publication

code_contracts.responsibility: Choose only a current-owner exact physical locator or a unique durable physical locator; consume no status as a verdict.
Sample exact canonical bytes and bracket segment, owner where applicable, generation, root, epoch, admission, and native status.
Apply the physical TT and native-status precedence without producing authority from projections.
Convert one exact authoritative TT result into SELF/ACTIVE/COMMITTED/ABORTED or UNKNOWN with bounded parent-chain validation.
Assemble the exact all-or-nothing proof set by member origin.
Apply native conflict semantics, wait policy, self-CID, updater successor proof, and UNKNOWN precedence.
Drive asynchronous per-segment canonical sampling without blocking under heap content lock.
Consume only a complete proof after exact tuple/page revalidation and restart at the owning native loop on change.
Define exact field-encoded transaction/publication/receipt/seal identities and closed typed results; define no transaction-status verdict.
Allocate a bounded PREPARED receipt and bind an exact open origin grant outside heap content lock; refuse capacity or drift before mutation.
Perform the only heap-lock-side target finalize/recheck and PREPARED-to-APPLIED release-CAS; never block, allocate, wait or mutate after returning retry.
Before ACTIVE/SELF proof enqueue, record exact touched participant and grant generation; drive capability-gated CTRC seal request/reply without changing status authority.
Remain the sole CTRC progress process and coordinate close, clean, ACK verification and certificate apply outside forbidden locks.
Discharge one exact target under Resource-X/page authority using the terminal-member table and successor-before-predecessor protocol.
Define opcode 0xA0 and the exact 96-byte release certificate payload with static offsets and no native-wire ambiguity.
Emit and redo the exact idempotent release certificate, setting only the release bit on an exact terminal predecessor.
Use two-phase canonical release proof for current allocator GC; L11 additionally retains the existing valid horizon.
Register/APPLY receipts for every retained ACTIVE publication and preserve exact native restart points; never publish an untracked successor.
Require the formation-wide CTRC capability and activation-sized shared memory before target OPEN.
Split ITL choice into a nonmutating exact plan and apply; finalize/APPLY one ordinary ITL/UBA receipt before the planned slot/page mutation, reusing only an exact existing per-page receipt.
Treat eager terminal stamping as receipt discharge only after exact terminal-independent projection and WAL/dependency capture; invalid/missing/skipped proof and NEEDS_CLEANOUT retain.

tests.purpose: Enumerate every bounded authority and composition combination; validate deterministic coverage, positive-row exactness, lifecycle totality, test references, and optional public-code anchors.
Current canonical ACTIVE positive requires exact physical bytes, owner, generation, root, and admission.
Current-segment ACTIVE with a retired or absent live owner remains UNKNOWN.
Exact terminal bytes plus matching native terminal state remain conclusive after stable owner retirement.
Rolled terminal uses a physical locator followed by canonical SCUR and never current-owner status authority.
Close the currently implicit rolled ACTIVE row and prove that no owner-index or native-only shortcut participates.
Empty, mismatched, missing, invalid, or recycled canonical bytes cannot be upgraded by allocator or rolled-live evidence.
Canonical/native terminal conflicts, incomplete commit SCN, and abort/commit disagreement remain UNKNOWN.
Every generation, segment, owner, root, epoch, and admission drift is attributed and cannot yield a positive proof; add table-driven rows for all matrix drift classes.
PREPARED remains distinct internally and is rejected by the Stage 8 current-MultiXact positive consumer.
Descriptor/proof requests are bound by origin, ordinal, full hash, request identity, and whole-list all-or-nothing assembly.
Enumerate native status, lock mode, member state, self, terminal updater, and successor decisions; extend to every aggregate composition rule.
Conflict selection is deterministic and wait policy maps exactly to WAIT, WOULD_BLOCK, LOCK_NOT_AVAILABLE, or BEING_MODIFIED.
Any UNKNOWN member or invalid updater proof defeats otherwise compatible or terminal members.
ACTIVE publication, prepared undo reservation, terminal transition, recycle template, and lock-order lifecycle rows have focused RED/GREEN coverage.

Minimal four-node current-MultiXact causal witness proves exact descriptor/member authority and must be extended with deterministic ACTIVE, COMMIT, ABORT, current-terminal, and rolled-terminal cuts before the broad immutable judge.
Unchanged t/400 must remain exact 236/236.
R11 target sole-path and source-removal proof remains exact 7/7.
PRE is final integration and performance evidence only after focused, causal, t/400, and R11 gates; it is not a state-space discovery loop.
An exact COMMITTED slot plus stable native in-progress remains conservative live with no commit SCN; it is never exposed as terminal COMMITTED.
ACTIVE/SELF proof carries a nonzero open grant only after exact touched-node registration; terminal/UNKNOWN grant is zero and all send-before-record cuts refuse.
Table-test every full-key/publication/target/grant predicate and prove PREPARED-to-APPLIED is the only positive pre-mutation transition.

All heap callers, including pending-ITL and pending-offnum paths, pure-plan then apply before ITL/UBA/descriptor/page/WAL mutation and restart before mutation on close/drift; forbidden slow symbols are unreachable.

Every shared ordinary ITL/UBA successor has an APPLIED receipt before mutation; invalid/missing touch proof, typed terminal-stamp skip and NEEDS_CLEANOUT retain, while exact durable COMMITTED/ABORTED page projection cleans.
Deterministic close-versus-APPLY schedules prove either tracked APPLIED or pre-mutation retry; PREPARED loss blocks ACK forever in Stage 8.
Exact current-page absence discharges only under successor-before-predecessor invariant; identity, page authority, HOT and descriptor ambiguity retain.
Table-test lock-only, aborted updater, committed updater, active companion, unknown companion and zero/one/many survivor rewrite outcomes.

Recomposition, HOT, prune, freeze, move/rewrite and KO/SMGR drop/truncate schedules cannot create an unregistered moved reference, remove the old target first, or return KO DONE before matching receipts are durably discharged.
Missing/dead/reconnected/drifted touched participants are never removed from the seal set and cannot yield positive ACK or certificate.

ACK requires exact per-key sequence 1..N, exhaustive counts, sole byte-exact N=0 tombstone form, stable double digest and durable local plus 16-entry dependency vector; inter-key global gaps are legal while per-key gaps/duplicates/insert-only WAL refuse.
Origin rejects omitted, duplicate, extra, stale, wrong-key or nondurable ACKs and emits 0xA0 only after final exact block0 terminal recheck.
Durable certificate sets only the exact terminal release bit, L11 still requires horizon, L12 does not invent one, and notification reclaims only the matching ACK summary.
Exercise every CTRC-C01..C09 cut and prove uncertainty before durable certificate retains while replay after certificate is exact and idempotent.
Release bit is legal only on exact terminal bytes, is cleared at terminal/recyclable/fresh transitions, gates every slot/segment reuse, and exact redo skips only proven newer identities.
Checked sizing uses the frozen formulas; allocation failure blocks OPEN and runtime full wakes the existing cleaner without eviction, deadline extension or page mutation.
Generated source manifest classifies every ordinary ITL/UBA and current-MX producer/mover/remover, terminal/recycle/reuse writer, flag writer and positive proof sender into one closed source class.
